name: advisor
description: One fresh, read-only consultation for material technical decisions in Codex CLI and Codex desktop.

interface.longDescription:
Codex Advisor automatically adds a fresh, read-only second opinion when Codex identifies a material unresolved technical decision.

Active routing uses advisor-astra with gpt-6-astra at low first, then only a verified adjacent escalation through medium, high, and extra_high (runtime xhigh). Legacy advisor-terra and advisor-sol names are compatibility aliases only and cannot select historical models. Project importance, security adjacency, or an ordinary architecture question alone stays Standard. Completion, reassurance, and final-diff-review requests stay outside the consultation lane.

Every consultation runs in a separate read-only, tool-free process. It cannot change your files, run commands, browse the web, or make decisions for you. You remain in control: Advisor does not implement, deploy, or perform final review.
